 Big Story Features Delhi Bengal Nation Opinion Editorial World Business Sports Entertainment Sponsored All Authors Home >  Delhi >  School holiday on Nov 16 for Chhath Delhi School holiday on Nov 16 for Chhath 
 BY  MPost 14 Nov 2026 1:21 AM IST MPost 14 Nov 2026 1:21 AM IST 
 New Delhi: Schools in Delhi will remain closed on November 16 on account of Chhath Puja, according to a circular issued by the Directorate of Education on Friday.
 The holiday will be observed in all government, government-aided, and recognised unaided private schools under the Directorate of Education, the circular said. 
 The decision follows a notification issued by the General Administration Department on November 9, stating that November 16, Pratihar Shashthi or Surya Shashthi (Chhath Puja), will be a holiday. 
 L-G notification declares a holiday across Delhi government offices, autonomous bodies and public sector undertakings.
